SELECT u.*, ur.role_name FROM user u LEFT JOIN user_role ur ON u.user_role = ur.role_id
AND u.uid LIKE CONCAT('%', #{uid}, '%')
AND u.user_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{userName}, '%')
AND u.user_phone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{userPhone}, '%')
AND u.user_email LIKE CONCAT('%', #{userEmail}, '%')
AND u.user_role = #{userRole}
AND u.user_status = #{userStatus}
ORDER BY u.id ASC
